description: no-op control: the unmutated source must pass the identity test
sigma support via a ddof = 1 variance > 0 instead of the distinct-clean-value test
justification: For n >= 2 both the ddof=0 and ddof=1 variance are zero iff all clean values are equal, so 'variance > 0' is equivalent to 'at least two distinct finite clean values'; for n < 2 both reject. The equivalence is asserted mechanically by test_sigma_support_ddof_equivalence for both the arithmetic and the production function (V2-M10, plan section 8).

description: rank method min instead of average in the clean rank base (tie convention)
suspect volume-rank movement ignored (every V box collapsed to its lower endpoint)
mu fixed at the observed mean (clean-clean crossing ignored)

edits.old:

    mu_hi = (clean_sum + math.fsum(box.hi for box in suspect_m)) / n_m
edits.new:

    mu_lo = _mu_obs

description: mu computed over universe members only instead of the full cross-section

edits.old:
mu_lo = (clean_sum + math.fsum(box.lo for box in suspect_m)) / n_m
    mu_hi = (clean_sum + math.fsum(box.hi for box in suspect_m)) / n_m
edits.new:
_uni = set(universe)
    _uni_m = [m_box[k] for k in sorted(m_box) if k in _uni]
    _n_uni = len(_uni_m)
    _clean_uni = math.fsum(box.lo for box in _uni_m if box.lo == box.hi)
    _sus_uni = [box for box in _uni_m if box.lo != box.hi]
    mu_lo = (_clean_uni + math.fsum(box.lo for box in _sus_uni)) / _n_uni
    mu_hi = (_clean_uni + math.fsum(box.hi for box in _sus_uni)) / _n_uni  # E-M3
